self.title: PSIPW 13th Award (2028): nominations for the Creativity and Specialized Prizes

collect_note: Reads the one dated nomination cycle printed on the official Nomination Info page ("31 December 2027: Deadline for receiving nominations") twice a day; the call is open until that date and the same call updates in place if the date moves. Chosen over the WordPress RSS feed (psipw.org/feed/ is news and laureate items only, 0 calls, rejected), the sitemap (no call URLs), the wp-json types (no opportunity post type; only Elementor/plugin types), and the Open New Nomination form page (/new-nomination/, which has no deadline text and only links the two PDF application guides). Prize, not a grant: nominations are self or institution nominations on the prize's own form, so auto_vet is left off and the item is a hidden candidate until vetted.
